quote: Furthermore, RA-HFLS treated by BAY11-7082 presented decreased VEGF, Ang1 and Ang2 expressions in a concentration-dependent manner.
summary: Ang2 expression fell when NF-κB was inhibited in rheumatoid arthritis synovial cells; not a colitis study.

quote: Selective inhibition of Ang2 throughout the infection by administration of either of two distinct function-blocking antibodies reduced the suppression of Tie2 phosphorylation and decreased the remodeling of mucosal capillaries into venules, the amount of leukocyte influx, and disease severity.
summary: Blocking Ang2 with antibodies reduced vascular remodeling, leukocyte influx and disease severity in mouse airway infection; not a colitis model.

quote: Among 950 differentially expressed genes, 19 were up- or downregulated (upregulation: ANGPT2, CHN1, CPXM1, CPZ, CXCL1, FCN3, GJC1, HSD11B1, LZTS1, MEOX1, MMP12, PLA1A, SERPINE1, SGIP1, and TRPC4; downregulation: FAM189A1, PDE6A, SLC38A4, and HMGCS2)
summary: ANGPT2 is among 19 genes up- or downregulated in inflamed Crohn's mucosa by RNA-seq; validation focused on CXCL1, not ANGPT2.

quote: Ten pro-inflammatory proteins were elevated in untreated patients and suppressed by corticosteroids (MMP12, IL22RA2, CCL22, IGFBP2, FCER2, LY9, ITGa1/b1, LTa1/b2, ANGPT2 and FGG).
summary: Serum ANGPT2 was elevated in untreated DMD and IBD patients and suppressed by corticosteroids, proposed as a pharmacodynamic biomarker.

quote: In a TNF transgenic mouse model of arthritis, the bispecific anti-TNF-Ang2 molecules showed a dose-dependent reduction in both clinical symptoms and histological scores that were significantly better than that achieved by adalimumab alone.
summary: Adding Ang2 neutralisation to anti-TNF improved arthritis scores in mice, so Ang2 blockade helped; an arthritis model, not colitis.

quote: HIF-1α and HIF-2α regulated NOTCH1, Ang2, and DLL4, which enhanced vessel-forming of endothelial cells
summary: Ang2 is one of several downstream factors regulated by HIF-1α and HIF-2α in gastrointestinal vascular malformation; no specific result for Ang2.

quote: Circulating levels of VEGF, PlGF, VEGFR1, Ang2, and Tie2 were significantly higher in CD patients than in healthy controls
summary: Serum Ang2 was higher in Crohn's disease patients than in healthy controls.

quote: Angiopoietin 1 (Ang1), produced mostly by pericytes and platelets, and angiopoietin 2 (Ang2), produced mainly by endothelial cells, bind to the same receptor (Tie2), but exert opposing effects on target cells.
summary: Review of angiopoietins in diabetic retinopathy, where Ang2 destabilises vessels and is targeted by faricimab; nothing on colitis.

quote: Serum and MCS concentration of VEGFA, VEGFC, VEGFD, VEGFR1, VEGFR2, VEGFR3, PlGF, Ang1, Ang2 and Tie2 were measured by ELISA.
summary: Ang2 was measured among angiogenic factors in serum and colonic mucosa culture of IBD patients, with local levels tracking activity; Ang2 itself is not singled out.

quote: Ang1 and Ang2 protein increased in M. pulmonis-infected mouse airways but came from different cellular sources: Ang1 was expressed in infiltrating neutrophils and Ang2 in endothelial cells.
summary: Ang2 protein rose in infected mouse airways and came from endothelial cells; an airway inflammation model, not colitis.

quote: Inhibition of Ang2 or TNF alone reduced the remodeling of blood vessels and lymphatics, but inhibition of both together completely prevented these changes.
summary: Anti-Ang2 antibody reduced vessel and lymphatic remodelling in mouse airway inflammation, and more so combined with anti-TNF; not colitis.

quote: To sum up, silencing ANGPT2 could improve LPS-induced inflammation, barrier dysfunction and ER stress of intestinal epithelial cells via blocking Notch signaling pathway.
summary: ANGPT2 knockdown reduced inflammation, apoptosis and barrier dysfunction in LPS-treated intestinal epithelial cells, a necrotizing enterocolitis model.

quote: High Ang2 concentrations turned out to be an independent predictor of severe liver dysfunction, as well as hepatic encephalopathy and renal impairment.
summary: Plasma Ang2 predicted severity and complications in alcoholic liver disease; not UC.

quote: Finally, patients with fibrostenotic CD were characterized by elevated VEGF and Ang2 levels, while patients with an inflammatory phenotype by elevated Tie2 and PlGF levels.
summary: Serum Ang2 was higher in Crohn's disease patients than controls, especially in the fibrostenotic phenotype.

quote: Disease activity was significantly increased in KO mice compared with wild-type and heterozygote mice (P = 0.033).
summary: Ang2 knockout mice had worse disease activity, lower survival and larger tumours in the DSS plus azoxymethane colitis-cancer model, suggesting Ang2 loss is harmful.

quote: VEGF, Ang1, and Ang2 levels showed statistically significant differences between UC patients and healthy controls.
summary: Serum Ang2 was higher in active UC patients than in healthy controls and was altered by corticosteroids; it did not track clinical activity.

quote: Creative emerging strategies encompassing cellular therapies, bispecific antibodies, and new targets such as CD40, DLL4, and Ang2, amongst others, are focused on inhibiting proangiogenic pathways more profoundly, reversing resistance to prior drugs, and modulating the TME to enhance therapeutic efficacy.
summary: Review of angiogenesis and tumour microenvironment in GI cancers that names Ang2 as an emerging target; no colitis content.

quote: Blood samples were collected, and angiopoietin-2 (ANGPT2), alanine transaminase (ALT), and aspartate transaminase (AST) serum levels were measured.
summary: Serum ANGPT2 was measured as a readout in a mouse sepsis liver injury model treated with bevacizumab; not colitis.

quote: activation of proadipogenic genes (ACACB, AGT, ANGPT2, FASN, RETN, SLC2A4)
summary: ANGPT2 is one of several proadipogenic genes activated in adipose tissue of macroH2A1.1 knockout female mice; an obesity study.

quote: Secondary outcome measures included additional immune (activated CD4, regulatory T cells) and inflammatory (hsCRP, D-dimer, IL-1b, IL-6, MCP-1, TNF, sICAM-1, sVCAM-1, Ang1/Ang2 ratio) markers.
summary: The Ang1/Ang2 ratio is one of many markers compared by HSV-2 status in HIV patients; no gene-specific result and no UC.

quote: IAV infection is associated with dramatic increases in programmed cell death ligand (PDL1) and angiopoietin 2 (Angpt2) levels.
summary: Angpt2 levels rose in mouse lungs after influenza infection and fell with adipose stromal cell secretome; not colitis.

quote: Here, we show that administration of MDP protected wild-type but not Ripk2(-/-) or Birc3(-/-) mice from colitis, confirming the role of the cIAPs in NOD2 signaling in vivo.
summary: Birc3-deficient mice lost MDP-mediated protection from colitis and had blunted NOD signalling, so cIAP2 supports a protective NOD2 pathway.

quote: We demonstrate here that cIAP2-/- mice exhibit profound resistance to lipopolysaccharide (LPS)-induced sepsis, specifically because of an attenuated inflammatory response.
summary: cIAP2-deficient mice resisted LPS sepsis with a weaker inflammatory response because macrophages died; a sepsis model, not colitis.

quote: TRAF2 and TRAF3 form a complex with the E3 ubiquitin ligase cIAP (cIAP1 or cIAP2), in which TRAF3 serves as the NIK-binding adapter.
summary: Review of TRAF-mediated degradation of signalling factors in which cIAP2 acts as part of an E3 ligase complex; no colitis data.

quote: This protection is associated with cAMP-mediated, rapid induction of cellular inhibitor of apoptosis protein (c-IAP)-2 and delayed induction of LIVIN, but not of six other members of the IAP family.
summary: cAMP and PGE2 induced c-IAP2 in intestinal epithelial cells, associated with protection from apoptosis; a cancer-focused study, not UC.
